title: NATURAL RIGHTS or THE RIGHT TO HAVE RIGHTS
description: ENJOY PHILOSOPHY MEETS WEEKLY EVERY SUNDAY BETWEEN 11.30 AND 14.30 AT EDUARDO VII PARK, HERE:\*\* [https://goo.gl/maps/5e3jKFEweXkNvDdK6](https://goo.gl/maps/5e3jKFEweXkNvDdK6) **ITS THE GARDEN BETWEEN THE “CARLOS LOPES PAVILLION” AND THE “PRAIA NO PARQUE” RESTAURANT AT EDUARDO VII PARK.** THIS IS A GROUP FOR ANYONE INTERESTED IN ENJOYING PHILOSOPHY. NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE IS REQUIRED. ONLY ETERNAL CURIOSITY AND THE PLEASURE OF KNOWLEDGE. PLS KEEP UPDATED of any changes and updates on our WhatsApp Group: [Enjoy Philosophy Lisboa Group Access Link](https://chat.whatsapp.com/GYP2kvajg8j3BGejCd8xVm?mode=gi_t) We will learn, debate, enjoy and investigate philosophers and diverse themes from the philosophical perspective. Each reunion is structured as a conversation among all attendees about that day s philosopher softly moderated by the organizer. The conversation will kick-off from the very brief suggested reading providing easy access to all attendees both to the philosopher and the conversation. Let´s be greek and dive today on… **Natural Rights... or in other words... the Right to have Rights...** **a millennial philosophical debate which is so critical to human life yet so intellectually complex, that some of the brightest names of the philosophical tradition gave it their bite... and yet a quick look at any newspaper express to which degree the conversation is polemic, relevant, pending resolution and in need to be talked again and again, as many times as necessary... that is our right... and we will claim it this Sunday.** **Natural rights as those rights that every person possesses simply by being human are Universal, Equal and Inalienable. They do not depend on nationality, social status, religion, gender, wealth...** **But the simple claim conceals a profound philosophical question:** **Where do these rights come from?** **WHY rights... at all ?** **Independently of which specifically are those rights, how much are they binding or how would they be enforced... are there Natural Human RIghts at all ?** **And the historical answers given to that very fundamental question are extremely relevant, of course: how Stoïcism, John Locke, Kant or Hannah Arendt answered undoubtedly shapes our world and our views... but they do not ANSWER FOR US.** **And given the compelling relevance of the matter, today s debate (the Epocal today and this Sunday´s today) should question it from today´s perspective... knowing what we know and being who we are... for many reasons.. one of them because the question seems largely unresolved.** **There is an inherent value in atempting to aswer by ourselves.** **It unveils the state of affairs in a crucial aspect where inaction is due to many reasons but also because the grounding is insufficient.** **And we can agree that all those promoting natural rights do not have to agree on why natural rights exist... but we can also conclude that whenever an action is taken by anyone, anywhere, subtle or shouted, today or in 19 years, in a house kitchen or in a battlefield, the individual standing in the name of natural rights does it from her own belief, a very concrete one, of why natural rights exists and matter.** **To her or him.** **That is all that matters.** **That she or he has one.** **Thats what we want to know. Which are those.** **Luckily, here there is more than one valid answer** **And thats great.** **Lets hear them.** **Nevertheless.. what really means to say that there are natural rights if those are not enforced remains largely an important debate in times where those realities co-exist: we largely agree on natural rights and those rights are meaningfully unanswered in those scenarios where they are, in practice, questioned.** **So, lets ask the whole thread from today, from who we are and where and when we are. Are there natural rights at all ? How binding are they ?** **Should this reasoning have a strong weight in our actions ?** **Let´s think about the Right to have Rights...** \-\-\-\-\- Our philosophy meetup has been, is and will always be totally, genuinely, joyfully and Radically free, in every sense of the words. That is the soul of our garden. Independently, if you would like to support our free house for philosophy, you are welcome. Contributions can be made by MB WAY to: +351 934 609 701 **No contribution at all whatsoever is required, expected or implied in any way to attend. This event is joyfully and radically free.** **You are always, always, always more than welcome.** And for those who feel that would like to, and can, support this project — here is the way. That is all.

title: People Of Lisbon Turns Six! World Cup Final Celebration
description: On July 13th, 2020, we published our very [first People Of Lisbon story](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CV0i_c0s3Rg&t=7s). Six years, more than 200 films later, [countless photographs](www.instagram.com/peoplelisbon), new friendships, gatherings, collaborations and adventures later, it feels like a very good excuse to bring everyone together. And what better occasion than the World Cup Final? So come to [Curva](https://www.curvapt.com/), the stunning outdoor space at Estádio da Tapadinha, home of Atlético Clube de Portugal. There’ll be a giant screen, food trucks, cold beers, summer sunshine and, hopefully, one magnificent final to watch together. This is a big, informal, free-for-all gathering. Come with friends, come alone, wear the colours of whichever country you’ve adopted for the evening, and help us celebrate six years of People Of Lisbon while watching the biggest sporting event in the world. Everyone is welcome. You don’t need to be a [People Of Lisbon member](www.peopleoflisbon.com), and you don’t even need to be a football obsessive. Come for the match, the atmosphere, the people, the food, the drinks, or simply to raise a glass to six years of stories from this wonderful city. The event is free, but please RSVP so we have an idea of numbers. Let’s bring the People Of Lisbon together for one big summer celebration. - People Of Lisbon began as a simple idea: to tell the stories of the people who make this city special. It has since grown into a film series, cultural archive and lively community, with our [People Of Lisbon Club](www.peopleoflisbon.com) bringing together curious, creative people through events, introductions and shared experiences. None of it would be possible without the support of our sponsors: Practice Portuguese, Moviinn, United Medical Clinic Lisbon and Fresh Legal Group.
